Appearance

On this page

In May, I've received a total of six donations and kind messages from very generous players around the world, I couldn't be more thankful of this amazing community that supports mod development this much.

I'd like to thank all players for being in this journey with me, I would have never imagined two years ago right now I would be creating mods for Minecraft and reach so many players from different countries.

This will be incredibly useful for when I'm not home for a few days or weeks because I'm busy with university, and unfortunately I just can't carry my whole PC with me.

All donations are incredibly appreciated and every amount counts, please send a message with your donation because I love to read those.
